# Commit Message

Generate a commit message for the current changes. Do NOT run `git commit`.

## Step 1 — gather context

Run these in parallel:

```bash
git diff --staged
```

```bash
git diff
```

```bash
git status --short
```

```bash
git log --oneline -10
```

## Step 2 — choose the diff scope

- If there are staged changes (`git diff --staged` is non-empty), use those.
- Otherwise fall back to all unstaged changes (`git diff`).
- If both are empty, report "nothing to commit" and stop.

## Step 3 — generate the message

Follow the project's conventional commits style observed from `git log`:

```
<type>(<optional scope>): <short imperative summary>

<optional body — only when the why is non-obvious>
```

**Types:** `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `docs`, `test`, `perf`

Rules:

- Summary line ≤ 72 characters, lowercase, no trailing period.
- Imperative mood: "add", "fix", "remove" — not "added" or "fixes".
- Body only when the diff contains a non-obvious motivation or breaking change.
- If the diff spans multiple unrelated concerns, say so and suggest splitting.

## Step 4 — output

Present the message in a code block, ready to copy:

```
<generated message here>
```

Then add one line explaining the type choice if it wasn't obvious.

+"""Departments table; employees reference a department instead of free text.
+
+Revision ID: de45fa67bc89
+Revises: cd34ef56ab78
+Create Date: 2026-10-18 02:00:00.000000
+
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+
+from alembic import op
+
+revision: str = "de45fa67bc89"
+down_revision: str | None = "cd34ef56ab78"
+branch_labels: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
+depends_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.create_table(
+        "departments",
+        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), autoincrement=True, nullable=False),
+        sa.Column("name", sa.String(length=255), nullable=False),
+        sa.Column("abbreviation", sa.String(length=10), nullable=False),
+        sa.Column(
+            "created",
+            sa.DateTime(timezone=True),
+            server_default=sa.text("now()"),
+            nullable=False,
+        ),
+        sa.Column(
+            "updated",
+            sa.DateTime(timezone=True),
+            server_default=sa.text("now()"),
+            nullable=False,
+        ),
+        sa.PrimaryKeyConstraint("id"),
+        sa.UniqueConstraint("abbreviation", name="uq_departments_abbreviation"),
+    )
+    op.create_index("ix_departments_name", "departments", ["name"], unique=True)
+
+    with op.batch_alter_table("employees") as batch_op:
+        batch_op.add_column(sa.Column("department_id", sa.Integer(), nullable=True))
+        batch_op.create_foreign_key(
+            "fk_employees_department_id_departments",
+            "departments",
+            ["department_id"],
+            ["id"],
+            ondelete="SET NULL",
+        )
+
+    # Free-text abbreviations entered so far become departments.
+    op.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO departments (name, abbreviation) "
+        "SELECT MIN(TRIM(department)), SUBSTR(TRIM(department), 1, 10) "
+        "FROM employees WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(department, '')) <> '' "
+        "GROUP BY SUBSTR(TRIM(department), 1, 10)"
+    )
+    op.execute(
+        "UPDATE employees SET department_id = ("
+        "SELECT d.id FROM departments d "
+        "WHERE d.abbreviation = SUBSTR(TRIM(employees.department), 1, 10))"
+    )
+
+    with op.batch_alter_table("employees") as batch_op:
+        batch_op.drop_column("department")
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    with op.batch_alter_table("employees") as batch_op:
+        batch_op.add_column(sa.Column("department", sa.String(50), nullable=True))
+    op.execute(
+        "UPDATE employees SET department = ("
+        "SELECT d.abbreviation FROM departments d "
+        "WHERE d.id = employees.department_id)"
+    )
+    with op.batch_alter_table("employees") as batch_op:
+        batch_op.drop_constraint(
+            "fk_employees_department_id_departments", type_="foreignkey"
+        )
+        batch_op.drop_column("department_id")
+
+    op.drop_index("ix_departments_name", table_name="departments")
+    op.drop_table("departments")

+from typing import Any
+
+import reflex as rx
+from reflex.event import EventType
+from reflex.vars import ObjectVar
+
+import appkit_mantine as mn
+from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
+from alloq_commons.components.forms import section
+from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
+    MODAL_CLASS,
+    modal_footer,
+    modal_form_layout,
+)
+from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import primary_button, toolbar_search
+from alloq_commons.models import Department
+from alloq_commons.state.department_states import DepartmentState
+from appkit_ui.styles import sticky_header_style
+
+
+def department_form_fields(
+    department: ObjectVar[Department] | None = None,
+) -> rx.Component:
+    """Form fields for the department add/edit dialogs."""
+    is_edit_mode = department is not None
+    return section(
+        mn.text_input(
+            name="name",
+            label="Name",
+            description="Eindeutiger Name der Abteilung.",
+            default_value=department.name if is_edit_mode else "",  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+            required=True,
+            max_length=255,
+            left_section=rx.icon("building-2", size=16),
+        ),
+        mn.text_input(
+            name="abbreviation",
+            label="Kürzel",
+            description="Eindeutiges Kürzel (max. 10 Zeichen), z.B. IT.",
+            default_value=department.abbreviation if is_edit_mode else "",  # type: ignore[union-attr]
+            required=True,
+            max_length=10,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _department_modal(
+    *,
+    title: str,
+    opened: bool | rx.Var,
+    on_close: EventType[()],
+    on_submit: EventType[Any],
+    submit_label: str,
+    content: rx.Component,
+) -> rx.Component:
+    return mn.modal(
+        modal_form_layout(
+            content=mn.flex(
+                content,
+                mn.space(height="2rem"),
+                direction="column",
+                width="100%",
+            ),
+            footer=modal_footer(submit_label, on_close),
+            on_submit=on_submit,
+        ),
+        title=title,
+        opened=opened,
+        on_close=on_close,
+        size="md",
+        centered=True,
+        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
+        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
+    )
+
+
+def add_department_modal() -> rx.Component:
+    return _department_modal(
+        title="Abteilung hinzufügen",
+        opened=DepartmentState.add_modal_open,
+        on_close=DepartmentState.close_add_modal,
+        on_submit=DepartmentState.create_department,
+        submit_label="Abteilung speichern",
+        content=department_form_fields(),
+    )
+
+
+def edit_department_modal() -> rx.Component:
+    return _department_modal(
+        title="Abteilung bearbeiten",
+        opened=DepartmentState.edit_modal_open,
+        on_close=DepartmentState.close_edit_modal,
+        on_submit=DepartmentState.update_department,
+        submit_label="Abteilung aktualisieren",
+        content=department_form_fields(
+            DepartmentState.selected_department.to(Department)
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def departments_table_row(department: ObjectVar[Department]) -> rx.Component:
+    return mn.table.tr(
+        mn.table.td(
+            mn.text(department.name, size="sm", fw="500"),
+        ),
+        mn.table.td(
+            mn.text(department.abbreviation, size="sm", c="dimmed"),
+        ),
+        mn.table.td(
+            mn.group(
+                rx.icon_button(
+                    rx.icon("square-pen", size=16),
+                    on_click=DepartmentState.select_department_and_open_edit(
+                        department.id
+                    ),
+                    variant="ghost",
+                ),
+                delete_dialog(
+                    title="Löschen bestätigen",
+                    content=department.name,
+                    on_click=DepartmentState.delete_department(department.id),
+                    icon_button=True,
+                    color="red",
+                    variant="subtle",
+                ),
+                gap="xs",
+                wrap="nowrap",
+                align="center",
+            ),
+            width="1%",
+            style={"whiteSpace": "nowrap"},
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def _loading_row() -> rx.Component:
+    return mn.table.tr(
+        mn.table.td(
+            rx.hstack(
+                rx.spinner(size="3"),
+                mn.text("Lade Abteilungen...", size="sm"),
+                align="center",
+                justify="center",
+                spacing="3",
+            ),
+            col_span=3,
+            style={"textAlign": "center"},
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def departments_table() -> rx.Component:
+    """Full CRUD interface for departments."""
+    return mn.stack(
+        add_department_modal(),
+        edit_department_modal(),
+        mn.table(
+            mn.table.thead(
+                mn.table.tr(
+                    mn.table.th(mn.text("Name", size="sm", fw="700")),
+                    mn.table.th(mn.text("Kürzel", size="sm", fw="700")),
+                    mn.table.th(mn.text("", size="sm")),
+                    style=sticky_header_style,
+                ),
+            ),
+            mn.table.tbody(
+                rx.cond(
+                    DepartmentState.is_loading,
+                    _loading_row(),
+                    rx.foreach(
+                        DepartmentState.filtered_departments,
+                        departments_table_row,
+                    ),
+                )
+            ),
+            sticky_header=True,
+            sticky_header_offset="0px",
+            highlight_on_hover=True,
+            highlight_on_hover_color=rx.color_mode_cond(
+                light="gray.0",
+                dark="dark.8",
+            ),
+            w="100%",
+        ),
+        w="100%",
+    )
+
+
+def departments_toolbar() -> list[rx.Component]:
+    """Toolbar actions of the department page."""
+    return [
+        toolbar_search(
+            DepartmentState.search_filter,
+            DepartmentState.set_search_filter,
+            "Abteilungen suchen",
+        ),
+        primary_button("Neue Abteilung", "plus", DepartmentState.open_add_modal),
+    ]

+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from alloq_commons.entities import DepartmentEntity
+from appkit_commons.database.base_repository import BaseRepository
+
+
+class DepartmentRepository(BaseRepository[DepartmentEntity, AsyncSession]):
+    """Async repository for department CRUD operations."""
+
+    @property
+    def model_class(self) -> type[DepartmentEntity]:
+        return DepartmentEntity
+
+    async def find_all_paginated(
+        self,
+        session: AsyncSession,
+        limit: int = 200,
+        offset: int = 0,
+    ) -> list[DepartmentEntity]:
+        """Find all departments with pagination, ordered by name."""
+        statement = (
+            select(DepartmentEntity)
+            .offset(offset)
+            .limit(limit)
+            .order_by(DepartmentEntity.name)
+        )
+        result = await session.execute(statement)
+        return list(result.scalars().all())
+
+
+department_repo = DepartmentRepository()

```
feat(departments): add departments and link employees and projects to them

Employees now reference a department instead of free text. The migration
turns the abbreviations already entered into departments. Also adds a
departments page and repository, an employee form state, project number
and category fields, and planning grid/gantt legend and readability tweaks.
```

The type is `feat` because the main change is the new departments feature.

The staged diff covers several unrelated concerns, so I'd suggest splitting it into these commits:
1. `feat(departments)`: the entity, repository, state, page, sidebar entry and `2026_10_18_departments` / `employee_department` migrations, plus the employee form and inspector changes.
2. `feat(projects)`: the `project_cats_number` migration and the project form and inspector changes.
3. `feat(planning)`: the legend, gantt, grid and filter changes with their tests.

The unstaged and untracked files (the dashboard portfolio models, services, tests and `doc/plans/dashboard-portfolio.md`) aren't staged, so they're left out. They belong in their own `feat(dashboard)` commit.
